cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Media Players 中启用 `AV1 software decoder for Electra`（`AV1DecoderElectra.uplugin`），并同时保持 `Electra Player` 可用，然后重启编辑器。
把 AV1 片源（常见为 `av01` 的 `.mp4` / `.webm`，或 IVF）放进项目可访问路径；该模块是 dav1d 一类的 CPU 软解，不会在内容浏览器里生成独立「解码器资产」。
新建 `File Media Source`（或 URL/`Stream Media Source`），指向上述 AV1 文件；在 `Media Player` 资产上把首选播放器设为 Electra，不要用 WMF/AVF 去解 AV1。
创建 `Media Texture` 绑定该 `Media Player`，赋给材质采样器或 `Media Plate`；蓝图里对播放器 `Open Source` / `Play`。Electra 会按四字符码自动选用 `AV1DecoderElectra`。
在目标平台用 `stat unit` / 媒体日志确认解码线程 CPU 占用；软解性能随分辨率与平台变化，Shipping 包需把该插件打进对应平台，不要只在编辑器启用。
游戏模块一般不必把 `AV1DecoderElectra` 写进 `Build.cs`：解码器由 Electra 工厂在运行时注册。只有写自定义 Electra 解码管线时才依赖该模块头文件。
en_steps: Enable `AV1 software decoder for Electra` (`AV1DecoderElectra.uplugin`) under `Edit > Plugins` > Media Players, keep `Electra Player` enabled, then restart the editor.

Place AV1 bitstreams (typically `av01` in `.mp4` / `.webm`, or IVF) where the project can read them. This module is a CPU software decoder (dav1d-style); it does not create a decoder asset in the Content Browser.
Create a `File Media Source` (or URL/`Stream Media Source`) that points at the AV1 file. On the `Media Player` asset, prefer Electra — do not expect WMF/AVF to decode AV1.
Create a `Media Texture` bound to that `Media Player` and sample it in a material or `Media Plate`. From Blueprint, `Open Source` / `Play`. Electra selects `AV1DecoderElectra` from the codec fourCC.
On the target device, watch `stat unit` and media logs for decode-thread CPU. Software AV1 cost varies by resolution and platform; include the plugin in the cooked platform, not editor-only.

Gameplay `Build.cs` files usually omit `AV1DecoderElectra` because Electra’s factory registers the decoder at runtime. Depend on the module only if you are extending Electra’s decoder pipeline in C++.
note_cn: 这是 Electra 的 AV1 软解插件，不是通用 Media Player。没有独立组件；片源必须是 AV1，播放器必须走 Electra。
note_en: This is Electra’s AV1 software decoder, not a generic Media Player. There is no component to add; the bitstream must be AV1 and playback must go through Electra.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Codecs / Experimental 中启用 `AVCodecs Core`（`AVCodecsCore.uplugin`）。多数项目是作为 Pixel Streaming、硬件编解码器等插件的依赖被拉起，不必单独做关卡里的「播放」操作。
游戏或功能模块的 `Build.cs` 按需加入运行时模块 `AVCodecsCore`（GPU 资源互操作再加 `AVCodecsCoreRHI`），然后 Generate Project Files。不要把该 Experimental 接口写进 Shipping 公共 API。
在 C++ 里通过 `AVCodecsCore` 的编解码上下文创建编码器/解码器实例，把待压帧从游戏/RHI 纹理交给 `AVCodecsCoreRHI` 做资源包装后再送进具体 codec 后端。
具体 codec（NVENC、VPx 等）是别的插件；本插件只提供公共 `FAV*` 设备/实例层。对照 `AVCodecsCore` 与 `AVCodecsCoreRHI` 的 Public 头文件选择实现，不要在蓝图里找「AVCodecs」节点。
用一帧已知分辨率的测试纹理跑通 Initialize → Encode/Decode → Shutdown；用日志确认 `FAVResult` 失败码来自设备创建还是码流，而不是媒体框架的 `Media Player`。
en_steps: Enable `AVCodecs Core` (`AVCodecsCore.uplugin`) under `Edit > Plugins` (Codecs / Experimental). Most projects pull it in as a dependency of Pixel Streaming or hardware codec plugins; there is nothing to drop in a level.

Add runtime module `AVCodecsCore` to your `Build.cs` (and `AVCodecsCoreRHI` if you share GPU resources), then Generate Project Files. Treat the Experimental surface as unstable for Shipping public APIs.
In C++, create encoder/decoder instances through `AVCodecsCore`’s codec context. Wrap game/RHI textures with `AVCodecsCoreRHI` before handing frames to a concrete codec backend.

NVENC, VPx, and similar backends live in other plugins. This plugin only supplies the shared `FAV*` device/instance layer. Pick types from `AVCodecsCore` / `AVCodecsCoreRHI` Public headers — there are no Blueprint “AVCodecs” nodes.

Prove a single known-resolution test texture through Initialize → Encode/Decode → Shutdown. Read `FAVResult` logs to see whether failure is device creation or bitstream, not Media Framework `Media Player`.
note_cn: 实验性 C++ 编解码抽象层，不是音频混合器，也不是 Media Framework 播放器。蓝图无入口。
note_en: Experimental C++ codec abstraction — not an audio mixer and not a Media Framework player. No Blueprint entry point.

cn_steps: 仅在 macOS / iOS / tvOS 工程启用 `AVF Media Player`（`AvfMedia.uplugin`）。Windows 上 `AvfMediaFactory` 不会注册可用播放器。
用 `AvfMediaFactory` 作为 Media Framework 后端：内容浏览器新建 `File Media Source` 或 `Stream Media Source`，指向 AVFoundation 能解的封装（MOV/MP4/HLS 等）。
新建 `Media Player` + `Media Texture`，打开该 Source。播放器名称应落到 AVF；`AvfMediaEditor` 只提供编辑器工厂/预览，不要写进 Game Target 的 `Build.cs`。
采集苹果摄像头或麦克风时走 `AvfMediaCapture`：创建对应 Capture/`Media Source`，选 AVFoundation 设备，再 `Open` 到同一个 `Media Player`。
把 `Media Texture` 接到材质或 `Media Plate`，蓝图 `Play` / `Pause` / `Seek`。真机权限在 iOS `Info.plist` 相机/麦克风用途说明里配置，而不是在 Windows 编辑器里测通。
运行时模块依赖 `AvfMedia`、`AvfMediaFactory`、`AvfMediaCapture`；编辑器扩展只放 `AvfMediaEditor` 到 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable `AVF Media Player` (`AvfMedia.uplugin`) only on macOS / iOS / tvOS projects. `AvfMediaFactory` will not register a usable player on Windows.
Use `AvfMediaFactory` as the Media Framework backend: create a `File Media Source` or `Stream Media Source` pointing at an AVFoundation-readable container (MOV/MP4/HLS, etc.).
Create a `Media Player` plus `Media Texture` and open that source. The player name should resolve to AVF. `AvfMediaEditor` is editor factory/preview only — never add it to a Game Target `Build.cs`.
For Apple camera or microphone capture, use `AvfMediaCapture`: create the capture/`Media Source`, pick the AVFoundation device, then `Open` it on the same `Media Player`.

Wire the `Media Texture` into a material or `Media Plate` and `Play` / `Pause` / `Seek` from Blueprint. iOS camera/mic usage strings belong in `Info.plist`; proving this on a Windows editor is not a valid test.
Runtime modules are `AvfMedia`, `AvfMediaFactory`, and `AvfMediaCapture`. Put `AvfMediaEditor` only in `*Editor.Build.cs`.
note_cn: Apple AVFoundation 后端。不能在 Win64 上当通用解码器；采集走 `AvfMediaCapture`，不是 Electra。
note_en: Apple AVFoundation backend. It is not a Win64 decoder. Capture goes through `AvfMediaCapture`, not Electra.

cn_steps: 启用 `Avid DNxHD® decoder for Electra`（`AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra.uplugin`）并确保 `Electra Player` 已开，重启编辑器。
准备 Avid DNxHD 编码的审查片（常见 `.mxf` / `.mov`）。本插件只解码 DNxHD 供 Electra 播放，不负责 DNxHR 导出。
创建 `File Media Source` 指向该文件；`Media Player` 首选 Electra。打开后 Electra 按 codec id 挂上 `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra`。
用 `Media Texture` / `Media Plate` 上屏，核对分辨率、帧率与色彩是否与后期交付一致。虚拟制片回放时把引擎 `Timecode Provider` 与片源时码对齐。
不要在蓝图里查找「DNxHD 组件」。游戏 `Build.cs` 通常不用链接 `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra`；只有扩展 Electra 解码器时才包含该模块。
en_steps: Enable `Avid DNxHD® decoder for Electra` (`AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra.uplugin`), keep `Electra Player` on, and restart the editor.
Stage Avid DNxHD review media (typically `.mxf` / `.mov`). This plugin only decodes DNxHD for Electra; it does not export DNxHR.
Create a `File Media Source` to that file and prefer Electra on the `Media Player`. Electra attaches `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra` from the codec id.

Display through a `Media Texture` / `Media Plate` and check resolution, frame rate, and color against the finishing spec. For virtual-production playback, align the engine `Timecode Provider` with the file’s timecode.
There is no Blueprint “DNxHD component”. Game `Build.cs` files usually skip `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra`; include it only when extending Electra’s decoder list.
note_cn: 只服务 Electra 播放 DNxHD。导出 MXF/DNxHR 请用 `Avid DNxHR/DNxMXF Media Plugin`，不要混用。
note_en: Decode-only for Electra DNxHD playback. Exporting MXF/DNxHR is the other Avid DNx plugin — do not mix the two.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Avid DNxHR/DNxMXF Media Plugin`（`AvidDNxMedia.uplugin`）并重启。这是导出编码器，不是 Electra 的 DNxHD 软解。
打开 `Window > Cinematics > Movie Render Queue`，把 Level Sequence 加入队列，在 Job 的 Settings 里 `+ Setting` 增加 `Avid DNx [8bit]`（名称随引擎小版本可能略有出入）。
输出容器为 `.mxf`。在该设置里开关 `Use Compression`（压缩 DNxHR vs 未压缩）、设置 `Number of Encoding Threads`。DNx 轨不含内嵌音频，再加一项 `WAV Audio` 以便后期合成。
C++ 直接写 MXF 时依赖模块 `AvidDNxMedia`，使用 `FAvidDNxEncoder`（头文件 `AvidDNxEncoder/AvidDNxEncoder.h`）：`Initialize` → 每帧 `WriteFrame` / `WriteFrame_16bit` → `Finalize`。当前 MXF writer 不写音频。
按 Avid 规格核对待机分辨率与帧率（例如 1920×1080 @ 24/25/30）。渲染完成用外部 NLE 打开 `.mxf`，不要用普通 `Media Player` 当验收手段。
en_steps: Enable `Avid DNxHR/DNxMXF Media Plugin` (`AvidDNxMedia.uplugin`) in `Edit > Plugins` and restart. This is an export encoder, not Electra’s DNxHD software decoder.
Open `Window > Cinematics > Movie Render Queue`, add a Level Sequence, and in the job Settings use `+ Setting` to add `Avid DNx [8bit]` (label may vary slightly by engine version).
The container is `.mxf`. Toggle `Use Compression` (lossy DNxHR vs uncompressed) and set `Number of Encoding Threads`. DNx does not embed audio — add a `WAV Audio` setting and mux in post.

For C++ MXF writers, depend on `AvidDNxMedia` and `FAvidDNxEncoder` (`AvidDNxEncoder/AvidDNxEncoder.h`): `Initialize`, per-frame `WriteFrame` / `WriteFrame_16bit`, then `Finalize`. The bundled MXF writer does not write audio.
Match Avid-legal resolutions and frame rates (for example 1920×1080 at 24/25/30). Open the `.mxf` in an NLE; a generic `Media Player` is not a finishing check.
note_cn: Movie Render Queue / `FAvidDNxEncoder` 出 `.mxf`。与 `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra` 职责相反。音频需单独 WAV。
note_en: Writes `.mxf` via Movie Render Queue / `FAvidDNxEncoder`. Opposite job from `AvidDNxHDDecoderElectra`. Audio is a separate WAV.

cn_steps: 启用企业插件 `AxF Importer`（`Engine/Plugins/Enterprise/AxFImporter/AxFImporter.uplugin`）。若构建未链 X-Rite AxF SDK，导入会直接失败，先确认该引擎发行版包含 AxF 运行时。
在内容浏览器 `Import` 选择 X-Rite `.axf`（Appearance Exchange Format）。工厂由模块 `AxFImporter` 注册，不要走 FBX/USD 材质槽去「假装」导入 AxF。
导入结果是一套 UE 材质 + 测量贴图（SVBRDF：漫反射、高光、法线、粗糙度等，视 AxF 模型而定），不是可播放网格。检查材质实例参数与贴图 sRGB/线性标记。
把生成的材质赋给静态/骨骼网格，在默认光照下对比测量球；AxF 是外观交换格式，几何仍用你自己的 FBX/USD。
`AxFImporter` 是编辑器导入器：不要写进游戏 Target。重新导入时覆盖同路径贴图，避免场景里旧材质实例指向失效纹理。
en_steps: Enable the enterprise plugin `AxF Importer` (`Engine/Plugins/Enterprise/AxFImporter/AxFImporter.uplugin`). Import fails if this engine build is not linked against the X-Rite AxF SDK — confirm the runtime is present.
In the Content Browser `Import` an X-Rite `.axf` (Appearance Exchange Format). The factory is registered by module `AxFImporter`; do not try to smuggle AxF through FBX/USD material slots.

The result is a UE material plus measured maps (SVBRDF: diffuse, specular, normal, roughness, depending on the AxF model), not a playable mesh. Check instance parameters and sRGB vs linear on textures.
Assign the generated material to your static/skeletal meshes and compare under a known light. AxF is appearance interchange; geometry still comes from your FBX/USD.
`AxFImporter` is an editor importer — keep it off Game Targets. Reimport over the same texture paths so existing material instances do not dangle.
note_cn: X-Rite `.axf` 外观导入器，产出材质与贴图。需要 AxF SDK；不是网格导入器。
note_en: X-Rite `.axf` appearance importer producing materials and maps. Needs the AxF SDK; it does not import meshes.

cn_steps: 启用实验插件 `BackChannel`（`Engine/Plugins/Experimental/BackChannel/BackChannel.uplugin`）。它给正在运行的 UE 会话提供外部查询/推送通道，不是关卡组件。
游戏或 Gauntlet 测试模块的 `Build.cs` 加入 `BackChannel`。包含 `IBackChannelConnection` 以及 OSC 实现 `FBackChannelOSCConnection`（`BackChannel/Protocol/OSC/`）。
在进程内 `Listen` 或 `Connect` 一条 TCP OSC 连接；外部工具按 OSC 地址模式发数据包。Gauntlet / 自动化主机常用这条回通道向 PIE 或独立进程注入命令、拉截图或状态。
实现 `IBackChannelPacket` 处理器，按地址分发：只处理你登记过的路径，避免把任意 OSC 直接映射到控制台命令。
用本机小 OSC 客户端先打通监听端口与一条回包；确认防火墙放行。接口随 Experimental 变更，不要作为 Shipping 公共协议。
en_steps: Enable experimental `BackChannel` (`Engine/Plugins/Experimental/BackChannel/BackChannel.uplugin`). It lets external tools query and push into a running UE session; it is not a level component.
Add `BackChannel` to the game or Gauntlet test `Build.cs`. Use `IBackChannelConnection` and the OSC implementation `FBackChannelOSCConnection` under `BackChannel/Protocol/OSC/`.

From process code, `Listen` or `Connect` a TCP OSC link. External tools send packets by OSC address pattern. Gauntlet/automation hosts use this back channel to inject commands or pull screenshots/status from PIE or a standalone process.
Implement an `IBackChannelPacket` handler and dispatch on address. Only honor paths you registered — do not map arbitrary OSC onto console commands.
Prove the listen port and one round-trip with a local OSC client, and open the firewall. The Experimental contract can change; do not treat it as a Shipping public protocol.
note_cn: 面向 Gauntlet/外部工具的 OSC TCP 回通道。无编辑器面板；API 以 `IBackChannelConnection` 为准。
note_en: OSC-over-TCP back channel for Gauntlet and external tools. No editor panel; `IBackChannelConnection` is the API.

cn_steps: 这是角色 FX 资产编辑器的基类插件（`BaseCharacterFXEditor.uplugin`），Groom / Chaos Cloth 等编辑器依赖它。内容制作人通常不用单独「打开 BaseCharacterFX 窗口」。
写自定义角色 FX 资产编辑器时，在 `*Editor.Build.cs` 依赖模块 `BaseCharacterFXEditor`（Editor 模块，禁止进 Game Target）。
派生 `UBaseCharacterFXEditor` / Toolkit，接入 Interactive Tools Framework 视口、工具命令与细节托管；资源类型用 Asset Tools 注册打开行为。
验证：双击你的角色 FX 资产应打开共用视口布局（3D 预览 + 工具板），而不是普通 Actor 细节。对照引擎里 Hair/Cloth 编辑器插件的依赖列表。
不要把该模块当运行时 Character FX 播放库。运行时 Groom/Cloth 走各自 Runtime 插件；这里只有编辑器骨架。
en_steps: This plugin (`BaseCharacterFXEditor.uplugin`) supplies base classes for character FX asset editors. Groom and Chaos Cloth editors depend on it. Content authors do not open a standalone “BaseCharacterFX” window.
When writing a custom character FX asset editor, depend on module `BaseCharacterFXEditor` from `*Editor.Build.cs` only — never a Game Target.
Subclass `UBaseCharacterFXEditor` / its toolkit, hook the Interactive Tools Framework viewport, tool commands, and details hosting, and register the asset type with Asset Tools.

Verify that double-clicking your character FX asset opens the shared viewport layout (3D preview + tool palette), not a generic Actor Details panel. Match how Hair/Cloth editor plugins list this dependency.
Do not use this module as a runtime Character FX playback library. Runtime Groom/Cloth live in their own runtime plugins; this is editor scaffolding only.
note_cn: 编辑器基类，给 Groom/Cloth 等工具提供视口骨架。不是可放置的角色特效组件。
note_en: Editor base classes for Groom/Cloth-style toolkits. Not a placeable character FX component.

cn_steps: 启用内容插件 `BaseMaterial`（`Engine/Plugins/BaseMaterial/BaseMaterial.uplugin`）。它几乎没有 C++ 模块，提供的是统一基础材质与材质函数库。
在内容浏览器打开该插件 Content（Engine 插件资产，过滤器打开 `Show Plugin Content` / `Show Engine Content`），找到随插件分发的父材质与 `Material Function`。
新建 `Material Instance` 继承该基础材质（或在自定义材质里调用其 `Material Function`），接入 Base Color、Metallic、Roughness、Normal、AO 等标准输入，避免每个资产再搭一套 shading。
把实例赋给网格，在相同光照下对比直连自定义着色器的旧材质。Fab / Megascans 管线常依赖这套统一层，改父材质参数会波及所有实例。
不要把插件 Content 复制进项目后再分叉一份「私有 Base Material」，除非你准备自己维护升级；引擎更新会改函数签名。
en_steps: Enable the content plugin `BaseMaterial` (`Engine/Plugins/BaseMaterial/BaseMaterial.uplugin`). It ships almost no C++ modules — it is a unified base material and material-function repository.
In the Content Browser, turn on plugin/engine content and open this plugin’s Content to the shipped parent material and `Material Function` assets.

Create a `Material Instance` from that parent (or call its `Material Function`s from a custom graph). Wire the standard inputs — Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, AO — instead of rebuilding shading per asset.
Assign instances to meshes and compare under a locked lighting setup. Fab/Megascans pipelines often sit on this layer; changing parent parameters affects every instance.
Avoid copying plugin Content into the project as a private fork unless you will maintain upgrades; engine updates change function signatures.
note_cn: 内容向的统一基础材质库，不是运行时组件。入口是插件 Content 里的材质/函数。
note_en: Content-only unified base material library, not a runtime component. Entry point is the plugin Content materials/functions.

cn_steps: 启用实验插件 `Batch Renamer`（描述符 `AdvancedRenamer.uplugin`，模块 `AdvancedRenamer`）。5.5 起常默认开启。
在内容浏览器多选资产，或在关卡/World Outliner 多选 Actor，右键选 `Batch Rename`（快捷键 `Shift+F2`），打开 Batch Renamer 对话框。
用面板操作组合规则：`Search`/`Rename to`（可切 `Regex`）、`Remove Old Prefix`/`Suffix`、`Add Prefix`/`Add Suffix`、`Auto Increment`、`Change Case`。右侧预览旧名→新名，确认无碰撞再 `Apply`。
资产重命名走资源注册表引用修复；Actor 重命名改的是关卡实例名。两类可以分次处理，不要指望一次操作同时改磁盘路径和关卡标签以外的包名。
大规模重命名后保存关卡与重定向器（`Fix Up Redirectors`）。`AdvancedRenamer` 只属于编辑器，不要加入游戏 `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Batch Renamer` (descriptor `AdvancedRenamer.uplugin`, module `AdvancedRenamer`). It is often on by default from 5.5.
Multi-select assets in the Content Browser, or actors in the level / World Outliner, then right-click `Batch Rename` (`Shift+F2`) to open the Batch Renamer dialog.

Build a rule chain: `Search`/`Rename to` (optional `Regex`), `Remove Old Prefix`/`Suffix`, `Add Prefix`/`Add Suffix`, `Auto Increment`, `Change Case`. Preview old→new names on the right and `Apply` only when collisions are clear.
Asset renames go through the asset registry and reference fixup; actor renames change level instance names. Run them as separate passes if you need both.
After large batches, save the level and fix redirectors (`Fix Up Redirectors`). `AdvancedRenamer` is editor-only — do not add it to a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: 编辑器批量改名：右键 `Batch Rename` / `Shift+F2`。模块名仍是 `AdvancedRenamer`。
note_en: Editor batch rename via right-click `Batch Rename` / `Shift+F2`. The module is still `AdvancedRenamer`.

cn_steps: 启用 `Bink Media`（`BinkMedia.uplugin`）。运行时模块 `BinkMediaPlayer`，编辑器工厂在 `BinkMediaPlayerEditor`。
用 RAD Video Tools 把视频压成 `.bk2`，再导入内容浏览器，得到 `Bink Media Player` 一类资产（不是普通 Electra `File Media Source`）。
创建 `Bink Media Texture`，指向该 Player；把纹理接到材质或 UMG `Image`。蓝图调用该 Player 的 Play/Pause/Seek，而不是 Media Framework 的通用 `Open Source`。
全屏开场片可走 Bink 电影播放路径：在 `DefaultEngine.ini` / 项目电影设置里配置 `StartupMovies` 等条目，让启动时解码 `.bk2` 而不是 WMF。
游戏 `Build.cs` 只依赖 `BinkMediaPlayer`。`BinkMediaPlayerEditor` 仅编辑器。Shipping 平台需包含 Bink 授权库；在目标硬件上看解码 CPU/GPU，不要只在编辑器视口点播放。
en_steps: Enable `Bink Media` (`BinkMedia.uplugin`). Runtime module is `BinkMediaPlayer`; the editor factory is `BinkMediaPlayerEditor`.
Encode video to `.bk2` with RAD Video Tools, then import it. You get a `Bink Media Player` asset — not a generic Electra `File Media Source`.
Create a `Bink Media Texture` aimed at that player and sample it in a material or UMG `Image`. Drive Play/Pause/Seek on the Bink player, not Media Framework `Open Source`.
Fullscreen startup movies use the Bink movie-player path: set `StartupMovies` (and related entries) in `DefaultEngine.ini` / project movie settings so boot decodes `.bk2` instead of WMF.
Game `Build.cs` depends on `BinkMediaPlayer` only. `BinkMediaPlayerEditor` stays editor-side. Shipping platforms need the licensed Bink libs; profile decode on device, not only the editor viewport.
note_cn: RAD Bink `.bk2` 播放器与 `Bink Media Texture`。不要当成 Electra 解码插件。
note_en: RAD Bink `.bk2` player plus `Bink Media Texture`. Not an Electra decoder plugin.

cn_steps: 安装 Blackmagic Desktop Video 驱动，再启用 `Blackmagic Media Player`（`BlackmagicMedia.uplugin`）。无卡/无驱动时 `BlackmagicMediaFactory` 枚举不到设备。
采集：新建 `Blackmagic Media Source`（`UBlackmagicMediaSource`），选设备、输入口、分辨率、帧率、色彩/HDR、音频声道与时码。用 `Media Player` + `Media Texture` `Open` 该 Source。
输出：新建 `Blackmagic Media Output`（`UBlackmagicMediaOutput`），配置填满输出标准。用 `Media Capture`（`UMediaCapture`）从视口、Composure 或渲染目标捕获并送 SDI/HDMI。
虚拟制片时在 `Project Settings` 对齐 `Timecode Provider` / 帧率，与卡上参考信号一致；nDisplay 或媒体 IO 面板里确认 Drop Frame 与信号格式。
运行时依赖 `BlackmagicCore`、`BlackmagicMedia`、`BlackmagicMediaOutput`、`BlackmagicMediaFactory`。`BlackmagicMediaEditor` 只进 `*Editor.Build.cs`。现场用 `stat Media` / 设备指示灯查锁定，不要只看编辑器预览窗。
en_steps: Install Blackmagic Desktop Video drivers, then enable `Blackmagic Media Player` (`BlackmagicMedia.uplugin`). Without a card/driver, `BlackmagicMediaFactory` enumerates nothing.
Ingest: create a `Blackmagic Media Source` (`UBlackmagicMediaSource`), set device, input, resolution, frame rate, color/HDR, audio, and timecode. `Open` it on a `Media Player` + `Media Texture`.

Egress: create a `Blackmagic Media Output` (`UBlackmagicMediaOutput`) that matches the fill standard. Drive `Media Capture` (`UMediaCapture`) from a viewport, Composure, or render target out to SDI/HDMI.
For virtual production, match `Timecode Provider` / frame rate in `Project Settings` to the card’s reference. Confirm drop-frame and signal format in nDisplay or Media IO.

Runtime modules: `BlackmagicCore`, `BlackmagicMedia`, `BlackmagicMediaOutput`, `BlackmagicMediaFactory`. `BlackmagicMediaEditor` belongs in `*Editor.Build.cs` only. Check lock with `stat Media` and the hardware LEDs, not only the editor preview.
note_cn: Blackmagic 采集卡的 `UBlackmagicMediaSource` / `UBlackmagicMediaOutput`。必须有 Desktop Video 驱动。
note_en: Blackmagic ingest/egress via `UBlackmagicMediaSource` / `UBlackmagicMediaOutput`. Desktop Video drivers are required.

cn_steps: 把 `Engine/Plugins/Developer/BlankPlugin` 整目录复制到项目 `Plugins/`（不要改引擎树里的示例当产品插件）。
重命名文件夹、`.uplugin`、模块名 `BlankPlugin` 以及描述符里的 FriendlyName/GUID；`BlankPlugin.Build.cs` 与 `FBlankPluginModule` 类名一并改掉。
在 `.uplugin` 里声明模块类型（Runtime 或 Editor），实现 `StartupModule` / `ShutdownModule`。需要 UI 时另加 `*Editor` 模块，不要把 Slate 链进 Game Target。
项目 `.uproject` 的 `Plugins` 数组启用你的插件名，Generate Project Files 后编译。日志里应出现模块加载，而不是仍加载引擎自带的 `BlankPlugin`。
示例默认几乎无功能：在模块启动里注册控制台命令或 Editor 菜单再验证。Developer 示例默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Copy `Engine/Plugins/Developer/BlankPlugin` into your project `Plugins/` folder. Do not turn the engine-tree sample into a product plugin in place.
Rename the folder, `.uplugin`, module `BlankPlugin`, FriendlyName, and GUID. Rename `BlankPlugin.Build.cs` and `FBlankPluginModule` to match.
Declare the module type (Runtime vs Editor) in the `.uplugin` and implement `StartupModule` / `ShutdownModule`. Add a separate `*Editor` module for UI; do not link Slate into a Game Target.
Enable your plugin name in the `.uproject` `Plugins` array, Generate Project Files, and compile. Logs should load your module, not the engine’s stock `BlankPlugin`.
The sample is intentionally empty: register a console command or editor menu in startup to prove it. Developer examples are not Shipping plugins by default.
note_cn: 最小插件模板。正确用法是复制后改名实现 `FBlankPluginModule`，不是在游戏里搜索组件。
note_en: Minimal plugin template. Copy, rename, and implement `FBlankPluginModule` — there is no gameplay component to find.

cn_steps: 启用 `Blend Stack`（模块 `BlendStack` + 编辑器 `BlendStackEditor`）。做 Motion Matching 时通常还要开 Pose Search。
打开角色 `Animation Blueprint` 的 AnimGraph，放入 `Blend Stack` 节点（运行时对应 `FAnimNode_BlendStack` / `FAnimNode_BlendStack_Standalone`）。
把 Pose Search 的 Motion Matching 输出、Chooser、或游戏逻辑要播的 `AnimSequence`/`BlendSpace` 推进该栈。调节 `Max Active Blends`、`Max Blend In Time to Override Animation`、`Store Blended Pose`，避免每帧重复 BlendTo 把权重重置为零。
需要惯性混合时在节点上开 Inertial Blend / Blend Profile。游戏线程通过 Blend Stack 接口请求新动画，而不是用 Montage 槽硬切。
对照 Game Animation Sample：Chooser + Blend Stack 选步态/坡度。`BlendStackEditor` 只提供 AnimGraph 细节，勿加入 Game Target。运行时 `Build.cs` 依赖 `BlendStack`。
en_steps: Enable `Blend Stack` (runtime `BlendStack`, editor `BlendStackEditor`). Turn on Pose Search as well if you are doing Motion Matching.
In the character `Animation Blueprint` AnimGraph, place a `Blend Stack` node (`FAnimNode_BlendStack` / `FAnimNode_BlendStack_Standalone`).

Feed it Motion Matching output from Pose Search, a Chooser, or gameplay-requested `AnimSequence`/`BlendSpace` assets. Tune `Max Active Blends`, `Max Blend In Time to Override Animation`, and `Store Blended Pose` so per-frame BlendTo does not reset weights to zero.
Enable inertial blend / a Blend Profile on the node when you need bone-aware blends. Request new animations through the Blend Stack interface instead of slamming Montage slots.
Use Game Animation Sample as the reference for Chooser + Blend Stack locomotion. `BlendStackEditor` is AnimGraph details only — keep it off Game Targets. Runtime `Build.cs` depends on `BlendStack`.
note_cn: AnimGraph 的 `FAnimNode_BlendStack`，给 Motion Matching/Chooser 做多层混合。不是 Blend Space 资产类型。
note_en: AnimGraph `FAnimNode_BlendStack` for Motion Matching/Chooser layering. It is not a Blend Space asset type.

cn_steps: 启用 `Blendspace Motion Analysis`（模块 `BlendSpaceMotionAnalysis`）。它给 Blend Space 增加根运动/位移分析，不是新的动画资产类型。
打开已有 `Blend Space`（或带轴的 Aim Offset），在编辑器的 Analysis / 分析属性里启用运动分析（速度、方向等来自根运动的量）。
对每个采样动画跑分析，让插件从根位移推导轴值，再把样本点放到对应 Speed/Direction 位置，减少手填轴。
在 AnimBP 的 `Blend Space Player` 上用同一套轴参数（速度、方向）驱动；分析数据用于编辑时摆点与运行时匹配，不是单独的组件。
根运动必须在动画上正确烘焙。原地循环且无根位移的片段分析会得到接近零的速度。运行时若要读分析缓存，依赖 `BlendSpaceMotionAnalysis`，以该模块 Public 头文件为准。
en_steps: Enable `Blendspace Motion Analysis` (module `BlendSpaceMotionAnalysis`). It adds locomotion/root-motion analysis to Blend Spaces; it does not add a new animation asset type.
Open an existing `Blend Space` (or an Aim Offset with axes). In the editor Analysis properties, enable motion analysis quantities derived from root motion (speed, direction, and similar).
Run analysis on each sample animation so the plugin derives axis values from root displacement, then place sample points on the Speed/Direction grid instead of typing axes by hand.
Drive the same axes from an AnimBP `Blend Space Player` (speed, direction). The analysis cache is for authoring and matching, not a separate component.

Root motion must be baked on the clips. In-place loops with no root displacement analyze near zero speed. If runtime code reads the analysis cache, depend on `BlendSpaceMotionAnalysis` and its Public headers.
note_cn: 在 Blend Space 编辑器里分析根运动以自动摆轴。没有可放置组件。
note_en: Analyzes root motion inside the Blend Space editor to place axes. There is no placeable component.
